# University of Colorado Boulder

> > Colorado's leading public research university since 1876, recognized as an R1 institution with Nobel laureates, MacArthur Fellows, and National Medal of Science recipients advancing innovation across academics, sustainability, and entrepreneurship.

CU Boulder is a major research institution offering comprehensive undergraduate and graduate programs, with strong commitments to community engagement, sustainability leadership, and industry partnerships. The university serves as a hub for innovation through its entrepreneurship initiatives and maintains a vibrant campus culture centered on the Colorado Creed and free expression principles.

## Academic Programs & Degrees

- [Academic Programs & Resources](https://www.colorado.edu/academics): CU Boulder academic programs with Nobel laureates and distinguished faculty

- [Majors](https://www.colorado.edu/academics/programs/majors): CU Boulder undergraduate majors: BA, BS, BFA degree programs
- [Minors](https://www.colorado.edu/academics/programs/minors): CU Boulder undergraduate minors complementing major areas of study
